description: Every avatar on this account, with the id you pass to startCall. Call this before writing code — avatar ids cannot be guessed. Callable means status 'ready' AND idleVideoStatus 'ready': the loop is attached. An avatar reads sourceKind 'video' once that happens, including the ones built from a single image — that is the normal end state, not a warning.
name: list_avatars
title: List avatars
